component.summary: Configure the desktop, devices, and system
डेस्कटॉप, उपकरण और सिस्टम कॉन्फ़िगर करें

description.p: Settings brings desktop appearance, shell behavior, connectivity, devices, accounts, and system facts into one native app.
Each pane reports actual Linux capability and keeps system services authoritative for privileged changes.
